name: Marie Borel
strongest_positive: Named treating/examining doctors and dressing attendants; actual published photographs; reported rapid closure of fecally draining external tracts and restored normal bowel function, with follow-up.
principal_limit: Internal tract network and newly formed tissue volume were not measured; several outlets may communicate. Closure was staged under dressings, with skin formation continuing later.
religious_connection: Several days at Lourdes and bathing; first four sites already closed before21August immersion in BMJ account, final recovery after22August bath.
ordinary_comparison: Visschers/Maastricht2012shows spontaneous postoperative fistula closure, but its convalescence clock does not measure last-discharge-to-final-seal time and is not a matched reconstruction.
assessment: Substantial testimony of organic recovery; stronger claim of a quantified biologically impossible deep-tissue generation rate is not demonstrated.

name: Vittorio Micheli
strongest_positive: Published paired pelvic radiographs and reported biopsy review; major durable structural and functional recovery.
principal_limit: Garner reports chemotherapy; Neilan says none. Original drug/treatment chart unavailable. Published1963film conflicts with laterfirst1964film wording. Normal function does not imply exact anatomical restoration.
religious_connection: Reported abrupt relief/appetite change in bath, walking over followingweeks withcast, bone remodeling later.
ordinary_comparison: Dissing/Copenhagen1978documents untreated malignant destructive pelvic-tumor regression overyears. Neither that report nor generic spontaneous-regression terminology establishes the cause of Micheli recovery.
assessment: Strongest structural-imaging candidate of these three; exact treatment and tempo must be retained rather than narrating an instantly regrown pelvis.

name: John Traynor
strongest_positive: Same three doctors reproducedpre/postexaminations,1924certificate and1926follow-up documenting durable major practical recovery.
principal_limit: Original operative and1923signed clinical sheets unavailable. Nerve re-creation inferred from function and prior history; skull narrowing initially and closure later palpated, not pairedradiographs. Residualclawhandandforearmdifference remain.
ordinary_comparison: No adequate patient-specific ordinary reconstruction recovered. Functional-seizure/paralysis labels must not be asserted as diagnosed facts without evidence.
assessment: Strong close-timing clinical testimony; precise anatomical claims exceed the recovered direct measurements.
